{"text":"ItemID: 1; Title: FlashFix | Super Glue Plus | Industrial Strength Welding Glue & Powder for Filling Gaps | Instant Cure Adhesive for Plastic, Metal, Rubber & More | Heavy Duty Repair on Cars, Boats, & DIY Projects; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Gap filling looks useful for my repair projects alongside the tapes and fasteners I already use.
ItemID: 2; Title: Ultrasonic Jewelry Cleaner, 650mL Professional Ultrasonic Cleaner with 5 Digital Timer, Degas Mode, 45kHz Portable Household Cleaning Machine for Eyeglasses, Watches, Rings, Necklaces, Coins, Dentures; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am focused on fabrication and repairs right now and have no specific ultrasonic cleaning job.
ItemID: 3; Title: Eshazu Superior Tack Cloths (Box of 06) - Tack Rags for Woodworking and Painters Professional Grade - Removes Dust, Sanding Particles, Cleans Surfaces - Wax and Silicone Free, Anti-Static; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: These would help remove sanding dust before finishing wood or applying epoxy.
ItemID: 4; Title: ETERART Duct Tape Haevy Duty Strong Industrial Max Strength Tape, No Residue and Tear by Hand, Multi-Purpose, Indoor & Outdoor Use, 2 Inch x 20 Yards (White); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Useful for temporary repairs, but I would pass this time because I already have several adhesive supplies.
ItemID: 5; Title: M5-0.8 x 10mm (60 PCS) Button Head Socket Cap Screws, Black Oxide Finish, 10.9 Grade Alloy Steel, Full Thread, Coarse Thread, ISO7380; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: These fit my interest in mechanical fastening, but I would check whether a project needs this exact length before buying.
ItemID: 6; Title: Clamp Multimeter Tester - 6000 Counts FKM True RMS Voltmeter for AC Current AC/DC Voltage Tester with Lighting System, Auto-ranging AMP Frequency Resistance, NCV Digital Clamp Meter; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Electrical measurements would complement my inspection camera, caliper, and temperature tools for troubleshooting repairs.
ItemID: 7; Title: Gaffers Tape - Professional Grade Gaffers Tape 4 Inch x 33 Yards, Waterproof, Non-Reflective, No Residue Cloth Camera Tape Multipurpose Matte Finish Black Gaffers Tape for Photography Filming Backdrop; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not currently need a wide matte tape for filming or backdrop work.
ItemID: 8; Title: Digital PH Meter, PH Meter 0.01 PH High Accuracy Water Quality Tester with 0-14 PH Measurement Range for Household Drinking, Pool and Aquarium Water PH Tester Design with ATC; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current water testing project that would make this useful.
ItemID: 9; Title: Rawall Pegboard Hooks, Large Diameter 50-Pack, 8 Inch L Shape Small Galvanized Pegboard Hooks Suitable for 1/4 inch pegboard,Metal Pegboard Hooks for Garage,Office,Kitchen,Store; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Organizing my growing tool collection appeals to me, but I would confirm pegboard fit and hook length first.
ItemID: 10; Title: Adhesive Guru CA Glue with Activator Woodworking (3.5 oz - 13,5 fl oz) Ca Glue for Woodworking, Cyanoacrylate Glue and Activator (1 Pack); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Quick setting glue would be useful for holding small woodworking parts during assembly."}
